source_note: Activity names, categories, units and work-package grouping are taken from the client's Daily Progress Report (MEJA_DPR, dated 27-08-2026) and Financial Progress Report (dated 01-08-2026) for the Prayagraj Ganga water supply scheme. productivity_rate / productivity_unit / base_crews are NOT present in the client data (which tracks cumulative BOQ quantities and billing, not day-rate productivity) and have been simulated using standard Indian water-supply pipeline planning norms, consistent with how the other mock templates in activity_masters.py were built.
